command:
set -euo pipefail
export AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-east-2 AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS=1
mkdir -p /work/cpu-round23 /work/results
cd /work/cpu-round23
aws s3 cp s3://isolab-results-104186811093-us-east-2/inputs/hashed-ecdl-cpu-round23-20261030/ . --recursive --only-show-errors
sha256sum -c input.sha256
chmod +x baseline candidate previous inverse analyze
export EPHEMERAL_OUT=/work/results
set +e
bash run.sh
code=$?
set -e
printf '%s\n' "$code" > /work/results/exit-code.txt
(cd /work/results && find . -type f ! -name manifest.sha256 -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum > manifest.sha256)
aws s3 cp /work/results/ "${ISOLAB_RESULTS_URI%/}/" --recursive --only-show-errors
printf 'RESULTS_URI=%s\n' "$ISOLAB_RESULTS_URI"
exit "$code"
